notes.title: HD Update
notes.content:
To celebrate the New Year, and, barring any major problems, the very last update for WTC 2 - Part I, this visual novel now uses HD resolution graphics.  In addition, a few new things have been added as well.

This is a much nearer to what I had originally wanted now and is a pretty good way to end this episode once and for all.

notes.title: Final update
notes.content:
The final update for Welcome To... Chichester 2 is here, and contains the following :

[list]
[*] Background graphics have now changed (and look great)
[*] Title sequence and end credits have been updated accordingly
[*] New intro sequence when starting a new game
[*] Story has been extended slightly and a new outro added (to tie into WTC 3)
[*] Spelling and various other mistakes have been fixed
[*] A few special effects added
[*] Two new Steam achievements added, and Internal awards as well
[*] Simple music player
[*] Replay from any of the six chapters (once you've reached them)
[*] Background viewer (once the game has been completed)
[*] One section of the story is now only available once the game has been completed once
[*] Can no longer rewind to the last choice
[/list]

notes.title: Update 28/1/2019
notes.content:
A small amount of achievements have now been added to Welcome To... Chichester 2

Unless any bugs are found, this will be the last update until WTC 3 comes out - hopefully by the end the year (or at worst Q1 2020).

There is also an addition ending scene to bring it into alignment with the last part too.

notes.title: Product Update
notes.content:
WTC 2 has now been updated with custom graphics.  In addition to that, the story has been slightly upgraded too.

At the moment, the Recap is missing - this will be added soon.

There will most likely be one more update when WTC 3 is released (possibly at the end of 2019 or early 2020).

notes.title: One last update
notes.content:
This final update (unless something major is found) includes :

* Chapter numbers now also include the chapter name
* Bust images now used
* New scene added (only if you buy the full game though !)
* Some new text (and a few other messages changed)
* Ending has now changed
* Few new sound effects added

notes.title: Update #2

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
I'm currently working on an update to add bust images to characters talking, making it easier to see who is saying what.

One special effect that was ignored (due to another special effect) will also be visible.

There is no current schedule for when it will be released, but it won't be particularly soon as WTC 3 is still being worked on
